scope.reason: Replay reads the stored source envelope and document objects through the ingestion parser, verifying each recorded digest and length; the parsed decision has no feature storage of its own. Revalidate deferred stored PDF payloads through the shared typed corpus-validation result; invalid textless structure is a classified no-document outcome, while readable source text and AST retain the same parser. Preserve PDF paragraph gaps, lettered items and the bounded first-page metadata table when rebuilding document text and block boundaries from captured PDF bytes. Rows without captured PDF bytes yield a metadata-only replay outcome and retain their applied parser version; populated historical rows require an explicit PDF capture refresh. Metadata-derived titles require extracted document blocks. Paragraph-gap thresholds derive from font metrics rather than the frequency of observed gaps. Paragraph text and block boundaries are recomputed from stored PDFs through the shared hard-wrap reader, preserving first-line and hanging indentation, line pitch and short final lines; multiline titles and all block anchors are rebuilt with document-unique identities; none has feature storage of its own. Recompute printed paragraph labels from stored raw: local duplicate or OCR markers preserve surrounding labels, and Czech and Slovak separate opinions have independent numbering scopes; AST roles and labels have no separate feature storage.
